precommitted_interpretation_checks: Q3 minus Q2 clearing and transaction fees decline 160.1 USD million; market-data and information-services revenue rises 4.4 USD million. The latter is a counterpoint, not evidence that aggregate revenue grew.

Q3 minus Q2 total revenue declines 154.4 USD million, operating income declines 156.7 USD million, and net income attributable to common shareholders declines 115.6 USD million. Total expense rises 2.3 USD million.
The two source tables give displayed current-quarter values to 0.1 USD million, so deltas are derived from rounded displayed inputs and should not be presented with finer precision.
The selected rows do not establish why transaction fees fell or predict a future return. No valuation or stock price is supplied; any thesis change must be bounded and source-linked.
